snippet.title: Crash N.Finite 3.9.0 - Available Now!
snippet.description:
This update is meant to complete part 2 of 6 of this game.
As with the previous ones, the game has been adapted to be a stand alone version. In this way each version of the game will always have something new or different compared to the previous ones. For this reason I strongly suggest to start a new game and delete all data related to the best times from the main menu.

This version includes:
-10 standard levels (same as the previous version, some have received changes).
-5 world levels
-2 Bosses
-2 Trial Levels
-New tasks
-General improvements on many elements.

Link:
https://gamejolt.com/games/CB_NFiniteDemo/805008
or
https://tomrus92.itch.io/crash-bandicoot-nfinite

-This is a reload of version 3.9.0, some minor bugs have been fixed in the Standard version available today.
Standard and Performance versions are included from today, it seems that the performance version can cause strange frame rate drops in some configurations.
I suggest you to play the standard version.

Also remember that the game requires at least 2gb of video memory to have acceptable performance.
Some levels are heavier than others but you can reduce the weight of some elements from the options menu.
Also, if you have a laptop, make sure to run the game using your dedicated gpu, you can manually configure it from your video card control panel.

The 30 fps version is being considered but for now I have no plans to do it.



#crashbandicoot #ps1 #crashbandicoot4 #crashteamracing #crashteamracingnitrofueled #fangame #playstation #playstation2
